title: THE GRACE OF THANKS
LUKE 17:15-16
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: misty countryside in soft morning light
golden light over calm river landscape
peaceful green valley with soft sunlight
morning mist rising over quiet meadow
serene woodland stream in golden hour

scenes.a: If that lingering ache in your chest has made it hard to look up today, stay right here.
Father, we confess how easily our blessings are consumed without a second glance backward.
Teach our spirits to remember Your mercy when the noise of the day tries to drown it out.
And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
Lord, give us this humble posture, recognizing every good gift comes straight from Your hand.
May our lips not just receive kindness, but return to offer genuine praise to Your holy name.
